1_gas_script_properties_9kb_limit_protec.mechanism: Moved persistent `processed_receipts` and completed `remote_branch_cache` to GitHub SSOT (`automation/gemini-notebook/state/loop_state.json`). Restricted GAS `RELAY_STATE_V1` (`gas_relay_compact_state_v2`) to compact transient fields and enforced `saveBoundedRelayState_()` trimming at <= 7,500 UTF-8 bytes (well under Google's 9KB limit).

2_duplicate_detection_completeness.mechanism: Added full `/branches?per_page=100&page=N` pagination, explicit `tree.truncated === true` error stop, and multi-run `partialScanProgress` continuation when markdown body scans exceed `max_blob_fetches_per_run = 25` (`PAUSED_INCOMPLETE_DEDUP_SCAN_CONTINUES_NEXT_RUN`). Never marks a branch `scan_complete: true` or treats deduplication as PASS while unscanned files remain.

3_github_rest_api_commit_to_tree_sha_ali.mechanism: Every remote branch now resolves `commit_sha -> tree_sha` via `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/commits/{commit_sha}` before calling `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/trees/{tree_sha}?recursive=1`. Mock server in `test_10` and `test_11` strictly rejects any `commit_sha` passed to `/git/trees/` with HTTP 404. Removed silent `continue` on remote branch API errors.

4_gemini_task_md_instruction_alignment.mechanism: Updated `automation/gemini-notebook/GEMINI_TASK.md` to remove outdated v0.3 GitHub Actions references and align with the v0.5 GAS direct atomic commit architecture, while explicitly maintaining that unattended Gemini Scheduled Actions -> Google Drive export and autonomous Notebook source registration remain `NOT_TESTED` / `UNKNOWN`.

5_value_level_validation_and_residual_ri.mechanism: Added recursive string value scanning (`forbidden_value_patterns` in `contract_spec_v1.json`) blocking GitHub/Google/OpenAI/Anthropic/Slack tokens, PEM private keys, Bearer headers, SRT/WebVTT subtitle timecodes, 3+ line timestamped transcripts, and >3 newlines in summaries/claims. Explicitly documented residual limits (short untimestamped quotes or unprefixed custom secrets cannot be 100% eliminated heuristically, hence isolation to non-default Draft PR branch).

verified_cases.evidence: Mock server rejects commit_sha on `/git/trees/`; verifies Commit->Tree SHA resolution, GitHub SSOT `remote_branch_cache` reuse, Drive self-healing, and compact ScriptProperties (<1KB).

Verified 2-page `/branches` pagination, 30-file multi-run partial scan pause (Run 1: 5 remaining) and continuation (Run 2: detects `dQw4w9WgXcQ` in `notes/note_28.md` on page-2 branch), `truncated: true` tree immediate error stop, `saveBoundedRelayState` <= 7,500 byte trimming, and value-level secret/SRT/newline rejection in both Python and JS.
